sections.Profile:
The "Evil Fight" pinball machine, produced by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in March 1980, is a solid-state, four-player game featuring a fantasy theme. The playfield is equipped with three flippers, one pop bumper, one mushroom bumper, five star rollovers, four drop targets, four standup targets, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, Solid State, Fantasy, 1980s
